gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Goldman spreads its wide letters out with generous clearance. Noto Sans Meroitic sits beneath with see-through c openings and lowercase that fills the line almost like capitals, so the heading's spacing meets a body that holds steady.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-multani: Commanding and wide, Goldman leans on its big lowercase. Noto Sans Multani adds a modern, lofty x-height plus an e with a wide gap at its terminal, and that open stance is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: Wide-set, round, bold: that's Goldman. Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke body, so extended reading feels clean and modern while the small letters stay thick with height, like bundled cable.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Big, brash and widely spaced: that's Goldman. Noto Sans Tai Tham keeps chalk-board lowercase crowding up toward the capital line while each c stays clearly open, so paragraphs feel contemporary and legible.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tc: Openness ties them together: Goldman's round forms read like open parentheses, and the curves of Noto Sans TC open outward instead of curling in.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Loud, wide and unapologetic, Goldman spreads out with generous clearance and big lowercase height. Noto Sans Telugu supplies the counterweight, its high-set midline and outward-connected counters keeping the pair professional rather than loud.
gen-flavors-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Whimsical Flavors carries diagonals as hefty as its stems and an x-height towering like a stubby pencil stroke. Flavors clowns around; Sofia Sans Semi Condensed keeps a clean, constant weight.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-kedebideri: Constant-width lines, short ascenders, tall x-height: Grandstander. Kedebideri takes up the same openness, with a skyward x-height line plus rounded, inviting letters beneath a heading with no swelling where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-matangi: Expressive, open, never curled shut: Grandstander. Shrink the heading and Grandstander loses its punch; enlarge the body and Matangi, with strokes like twine pressed into a flat surface, begins crowding it.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mozilla-headline: Constant pen-pressure swagger, short ascenders: that's Grandstander. Let the heading go large and Mozilla Headline stay modest, since its big-bodied lowercase and splayed c terminal already carry plenty of presence.
